comparisons.peer_topic: Credit Derivatives Business Overview and Risk Management
comparisons.peer_summary: Citi trades credit derivatives, including credit default swaps and total return swaps, to mitigate credit risk and facilitate client transactions. Counterparty credit risk is managed through master netting, collateral agreements, and daily margin settlement, with most top counterparts being central clearing houses or financial institutions whose contracts lack ratings-based termination events, though downgrades may lower collateral thresholds.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and C describe executing derivatives with large financial institutions and utilizing master netting agreements, collateral agreements, and daily margin settlement to manage counterparty credit risk. BAC states it executes most OTC derivatives with large international financial institutions on a daily margin basis using master netting agreements, while C similarly manages counterparty credit risk through master netting, collateral, and daily margin settlement, with top counterparts being financial institutions.

sentences.text: The Corporation executes the majority of its derivative contracts in the OTC market with large, international financial institutions, including broker-dealers and, to a lesser degree, with a variety of nonfinancial companies.
A significant majority of the derivative transactions are executed on a daily margin basis.

Further, as previously discussed on page 158, the Corporation enters into legally enforceable master netting agreements that reduce risk by permitting closeout and netting of transactions with the same counterparty upon the occurrence of certain events.
Citi also uses credit derivatives to help mitigate credit risk in its corporate and consumer loan portfolios and other cash positions and to facilitate client transactions.
Citi manages counterparty credit risk arising from credit derivative contracts primarily through master netting agreements, collateral agreements and daily margin settlement requirements.
A majority of Citi's top 15 counterparties (by receivable balance owed to Citi) are central clearing houses, banks, financial institutions or other dealers.

comparisons.peer_topic: Presentation of Financial Instruments on Consolidated Balance Sheets
comparisons.peer_summary: Derivatives are reported on a net-by-counterparty basis when enforceable netting agreements exist and net of cash collateral under enforceable credit support agreements; however, resale/repurchase and securities borrowing/loaning transactions are not reported net of collateral.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures highlight the use of enforceable master netting agreements and cash collateral to reduce derivative exposures. BAC notes it enters into legally enforceable master netting agreements to reduce risk, while GS reports derivatives are reported net of cash collateral received and posted under enforceable credit support agreements when transacted under an enforceable netting agreement.

sentences.text: Further, as previously discussed on page 158, the Corporation enters into legally enforceable master netting agreements that reduce risk by permitting closeout and netting of transactions with the same counterparty upon the occurrence of certain events.

In the consolidated balance sheets, derivatives are reported net of cash collateral received and posted under enforceable credit support agreements, when transacted under an enforceable netting agreement.

comparisons.peer_topic: Derivative Netting and Cash Collateral Treatment
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm elects to net derivative receivables and payables with related cash collateral when legally enforceable master netting agreements exist, noting that applying netting would reduce Level 3 balances.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and JPM describe using legally enforceable master netting agreements to net derivative positions and related cash collateral. BAC uses master netting agreements to reduce risk and executes on a daily margin basis, while JPM elects to net derivative receivables/payables and related cash collateral when a legally enforceable master netting agreement exists.
